messages.subject: Error trying to use covariance matrix
parts:
Hello,

Due to the difficulty in running lavaan's sem using the regular data structure, I tried to use a covariance matrix on a reduced part of my data set, for test, but got an error message:

teste=cbind(foliar,dens,sla,cres.adult,cresc.adult.perc95)
covs=cov(teste) # Obtem matriz de covariancias
covs[upper.tri(covs)] = "" #Esvazia a metade superior desta matriz, mas põe "" nos vazios
data.frame(covs) #Recoloca a matriz na forma numerica, trocando as "" por vazios verdadeiros
covar = getCov(covs, lower = F, names=c("foliar","dens","sla","cres.adult","cresc.adult.perc95"))

model = '
# Latent variables

cap.tol =~ foliar + sla + dens
growth =~ cres.adult + cresc.adult.perc95

# Regressions between latent variables

growth ~ cap.tol

# Residual correlations

foliar ~~ sla + dens
sla ~~ dens
cres.adult ~~ cresc.adult.perc95
'

fit = sem(model, cov=covar, sample.nobs = 66)

Error in sem(model, cov = covar, sample.nobs = 66) :
unused argument(s) in (cov = covar)

I have checked and rechecked the data, but the names of variables and their order is exactly the same. Any ideas?

All the best,

Alexandre
